title: How to Check and Remove Metadata from a PDF
description: Understand common PDF metadata fields, review them before sharing, and learn what metadata removal can and cannot guarantee.
intro: PDF metadata can include a title, author, subject, keywords, software names and dates. Reviewing document properties before distribution can help you share only the information you intend to disclose.

sections.heading: What PDF metadata can contain
paragraphs: Common document properties include title, author, subject, keywords, creator and producer. Some PDFs can also contain XMP metadata or other structures written by editing software.
Metadata is separate from visible page text. Removing a property does not automatically redact names, comments, annotations, form fields or other information visible inside the document.

sections.heading: Inspect before changing
paragraphs: Review the document properties and determine which fields should be removed. Consider whether the recipient needs a meaningful title or author field for their workflow.
For sensitive documents, inspect page content and interactive features as well as metadata. Metadata cleanup is only one part of a broader document review.

sections.heading: Create and inspect a cleaned copy
paragraphs: Use Remove PDF Metadata to inspect supported properties and create a separate cleaned copy. The tool page explains the limits of the underlying PDF engine; some extended metadata structures written by other editors may not be fully removed.

After processing, inspect the result again and retain the original. If you need to hide visible content, use an appropriate redaction workflow and verify the redaction; simply drawing a box over text is not the same as removing it.

faq.question: Does metadata removal redact visible text?
faq.answer: No. Document properties and visible page content are different. Review or redact page content separately when necessary.

faq.question: Can every metadata field always be removed?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. PDF engines differ, and extended metadata structures may remain. Check the output and the tool's stated limitations.

faq.question: Will removing metadata change the PDF pages?
faq.answer: The tool targets document properties, but always compare and inspect the output before relying on it.

faq.question: Should I keep the original PDF?
faq.answer: Yes. The tool creates a separate cleaned file; retaining the original lets you recover or repeat the work.
